_about: Airbus A300 Airplane Characteristics for Airport Planning (Rev 22, Dec 01/09), 2.2 General Dimensions, Model B2-B4 (Feb. 1980; page index 28), a scan on graph paper: layers.py --mode image at scale 5, clip 110,380,555,525 (side). Pixels of that raster, line centres. The grid's lines run through the drawing: the cabin's crown runs along one (369-377 px, the crown's line its upper part), and the nose tip sits on another. The belly's line is thick and doubled by a dashed line under the cabin: its level run is placed by its middle (free points, 588-589 px). The nacelle hides the belly from its inlet to its exhaust (hidden). The side view draws the flaps extended, below and behind the wing: not traced (the wing is the plan's and front view's). The long low fairing drawn on the crown over the wing (1060-1390 px) is left out of the crown. Aft, the belly is the lower of the tail cone's lines (the tailplane's own outline lies between it and the crown).
